$comment: The numbers that belong to no one entry of a catalogue, Adam's to tune: every one a first draft, taken over on 2026-10-16 from the constants they were in the code. Each is read at the moment it decides something, and what it decided is written into the event, so a retune changes what happens next and never what happened. An entry's own numbers live with the entry, in its catalogue: a structure's yield is the structure's. The game server takes on a change while it runs; /admin/inspect-balance shows and edits them. See decision record 0097.

roll.$comment: A choice roll: what it costs in wealth, how many options a hand deals (two to four), the chance out of a hundred of each rarity, which no omen moves, and what an action of each rarity grants of its resource. A common pays a roll back and a little more.

omens.$comment: When an omen is read at a roll. A house is weak for so many world-days after its founding (730 is two world-years, about twenty-four real days) and pious from so much piety. A kind of ground is an omen when it is this share of the revealed land in the circle the player is looking at; a river only when that circle is this many kilometres across or less, because from further out every land has one; the nearest few houses and towns by name only when it is this close.

islands.$comment: A land mass smaller than this many square kilometres is an island: between the largest island and the smallest continent on the master, measured on 2026-10-15 at 2.15 million, Greenland, and 5.84 million, the land Adam set at 45 south.

newcomers.$comment: The youngest and the oldest a newcomer can be, in whole years: grown, and with years left.

challenge.$comment: A challenge, not in the game yet: how far the tug runs either way from the middle; what a building put on the line pays as it arrives, for each of its levels, and the shares of that it pulls a second and adds to its slice's integrity, a person's lent stat standing in for it when one is put on the line; the effectiveness out of a hundred a building or a person loses when killed on the line; and the slice every house starts with, which the simulator begins a new slice at. The aspect boost is not here: it is the buff empowered, in challenges.json.

houseBots.$comment: The house bots the world opens with, each a player the world plays (decision record 0108). At most this count of them, the towns of 1790 taken most important first; each seat stands so many kilometres past the edge of its town's ruin, on land, and no nearer another bot's seat than apartKm. A town with no room for one is passed over. Raising the count makes more at the next opening; lowering it takes none away.

settlements.$comment: The villages and fishing villages nobody holds, which the opening raises on every settlement site the world lacks (decision record 0114). None is raised on a site nearer than clearKm to another structure's seat, a house bot's castle among them, so that no village stands on a castle. Where the sites are is world/settlements.json's.
